# `/outliers` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /outliers/v1

`getIdentityOutliersV1` — Iai get identity outliers — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a list of outliers, containing data such as identity ID, outlier type, detection dates, identity attributes, if identity is ignored, and certification information.

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage, iai:outliers:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `type` (query) — one of LOW_SIMILARITY, STRUCTURAL — Type of the identity outliers snapshot to filter on
  - `filters` (query) — fields: attributes: eq, sw, co, in; firstDetectionDate: ge, le; certStatus: eq; ignored: eq; score: ge, le — e.g. `attributes.displayName sw "John" and certStatus eq "false"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: firstDetectionDate, attributes, score — e.g. `attributes.displayName,firstDetectionDate,-score`
- Returns 200: array of outlier

### GET /outliers/v1/{outlierId}/contributing-features

`getPeerGroupOutliersContributingFeaturesV1` — Get identity outlier's contibuting features — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a list of contributing feature objects for a single outlier. The object contains: feature name, feature value type, value, importance, display name (translated text or message key), description (translated text or message key), translation messages object.

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage, iai:outliers:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `include-translation-messages` (query) — Whether or not to include translation messages object in returned response
  - `outlierId` (path, required) — The outlier id
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: importance — e.g. `importance`
- Returns 200: array of outliercontributingfeature

### GET /outliers/v1/{outlierId}/feature-details/{contributingFeatureName}/access-items

`listOutliersContributingFeatureAccessItemsV1` — Gets a list of access items associated with each identity outlier contributing feature — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a list of the enriched access items associated with each feature filtered by the access item type. The object contains: accessItemId, display name (translated text or message key), description (translated text or message key), accessType, sourceName, extremelyRare.

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage, iai:outliers:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `outlierId` (path, required) — The outlier id
  - `contributingFeatureName` (path, required) — one of radical_entitlement_count, entitlement_count, max_jaccard_similarity, mean_max_bundle_concurrency, single_entitlement_bundle_count, peerless_score — The name of contributing feature
  - `accessType` (query) — The type of access item for the identity outlier contributing feature. If not provided, it returns all.
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: displayName — e.g. `displayName`
- Returns 200: array of outlierscontributingfeatureaccessitems

### POST /outliers/v1/ignore

`ignoreIdentityOutliersV1` — Iai identity outliers ignore — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API receives a list of identity IDs in the request, changes the outliers to be ignored.

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): array of string
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /outliers/v1/unignore

`unIgnoreIdentityOutliersV1` — Iai identity outliers unignore — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API receives a list of identity IDs in the request, changes the outliers to be un-ignored.

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): array of string
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /outliers/v1/export

`exportOutliersZipV1` — Iai identity outliers export — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API exports a list of ignored outliers to a CSV as well as list of non-ignored outliers to a CSV. These two CSVs will be zipped and exported. Columns will include: identityId, type, firstDetectionDate, latestDetectionDate, ignored, & attributes (defined set of identity attributes).

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage, iai:outliers:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `type` (query) — one of LOW_SIMILARITY, STRUCTURAL — Type of the identity outliers snapshot to filter on
- Returns 200: no body
